purpose: Every decision that must be taken in writing before any DISTRIBUTION of an R0-prime artifact. A private candidate build may proceed while decisions are OPEN. status is OPEN until the owner (and counsel where 'decides' names counsel) has decided; only a person can change it. A DECIDED entry must carry chosen_option, decision_reference (the signed docs/legal/OWNER_DECISION_FORM.md record), decision_sha256 (sha256 of that record), decided_by and decided_on (YYYY-MM-DD) and, when counsel decides, counsel_reference. TRUST BOUNDARY: a DECIDED entry is plain repository data. The hashes in it (decision_sha256, the sha256 of a slot text) prove CONSISTENCY between the entry and the files it names, a tripwire against drift and mistakes; they prove no authenticity: any editor of the repository can write a DECIDED entry with invented files and matching hashes. A DISTRIBUTION build therefore additionally requires a detached SSHSIG (namespace redevops-legal-decision@v1) next to every record and approved text, made by a key listed in packaging/legal-allowed-signers (ships empty: until the owner supplies a public key, every DECIDED entry fails a distribution build).
wording_rule: No entry says that anything is cleared, compliant or permitted.
slot_texts_schema: OPTIONAL object `slot_texts` on a DECIDED entry: {"<slot id>": {"file": "docs/legal/approved/<name>.txt", "sha256": "<64 hex of that file>"}} or, only for LEGAL.SECTION13_NOTICE, {"not_applicable": true}. The About page has five legal slots (LEGAL.COPYRIGHT_LINE: D-LIC-1; LEGAL.LICENCE_STATEMENT: D-LIC-1, D-LIC-15; LEGAL.SOURCE_OFFER: D-LIC-12, pins-03, pins-04; LEGAL.NO_WARRANTY: D-LIC-10; LEGAL.SECTION13_NOTICE: D-LIC-5). A slot is filled only when EVERY decision it lists is DECIDED (with its written record) and the FIRST decision listed carries the slot_texts entry for it and the named file hashes to that sha256; otherwise the About page shows a neutral placeholder in a private candidate and a distribution build fails (packaging/check-distribution-gate.py --about-slots; packaging/notices/generate_about.py exits 3). An OPEN entry must not carry slot_texts; a DECIDED slot whose text is missing or does not match is an error in every build mode. No text file exists yet and no decision is DECIDED. The sha256 in slot_texts proves consistency between this entry and the text file, not authenticity or approval; the detached signature `<file>.sig` (namespace redevops-legal-decision@v1, key in packaging/legal-allowed-signers) is what a distribution build checks for authenticity.
